scope: Factory exterior paint evidence for the full size K5 Blazer through 1982 and the compact S or T Blazer from 1995 through 2005. Each model year and lineage remains source scoped. No color, paint program, top, stripe, or restriction is projected from an adjacent year or another Chevrolet truck line.

row_contract.color_legend: Exact source labels keyed by the printed paint code. When a source lists a color name without a code, the key begins uncoded: and is an audit identifier, not a GM code.
row_contract.solid_rows: Color legend keys that the cited table or year specific paint list makes available as regular exterior paint.
row_contract.two_tone_rows: Ordered [color_code_1, color_code_2] pairs. The order is the application order printed by GM and is not interchangeable.
row_contract.stripe_rows: Ordered [color_code_1, color_code_2, source stripe label] rows transcribed from a special paint package table.
row_contract.stripe_availability_rows: Ordered [body_color_code, stripe_or_decal_option_code] rows. These describe an available stripe or decal on a solid body color, not a two tone body paint pair.
row_contract.specialty_rows: Objects that preserve a specialty paint program code, printed color name, and restrictions. A program code is not silently converted into a body paint code.
row_contract.top_rows: Objects that preserve removable hardtop or folding top colors, codes when printed, and program scope.
row_contract.source_pages: One based PDF page numbers. Printed page locators, issue dates, and revision dates are retained beside each table.
row_contract.duplicate_editions: A duplicate or reordered retained GM packet is identified separately and never treated as a second independent availability source.

method: Used retained GM Heritage Vehicle Information Kit PDFs as the primary availability authority.
Matched every cited PDF to the crawler artifact ledger by SHA-256, byte length, page count, object path, and completed integrity status.
Rendered and visually reviewed every cited table page. OCR and candidate parquet rows were finding aids only.
Reviewed every page of packets that lacked an OCR color-table candidate before recording the packet as incomplete.
Kept full size K5 and compact S or T Blazer evidence separate and did not substitute Suburban, pickup, Tahoe, TrailBlazer, or adjacent year palettes.
